category: usenet provider (French-language, volume plans and paid trials)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Paid test offers, limited to one per customer: 5 GB for 5 days at USD 0.99 and 10 GB for 10 days at USD 1.99.
free_tier.notes: The test offers are priced, so they are not free.

retention.stated: More than 1500 days of binary retention

egress.terms: Metered on seven monthly volume plans from 3 GB; an unlimited plan exists

interface_detail: NNTP with 256-bit SSL on ports 563, 80, 81, 465 and 993
chaining: Cheap entry for a small volume (3 GB for USD 2.99 a month); the per-GB price falls as the plan grows, and a 1000 GB yearly volume plan is the bulk route.

limits.value: monthly plans 3 GB to 75 GB, an unlimited plan, and one-year volume plans of 50 GB to 1000 GB

binding_note: All but the IXIFULL plan are bounded by a fixed volume.
